desc: The home tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}): the Boki garden's four steps, one banner line each, a Skip always on screen (DECISIONS 2026-11-09: nobody gathers or builds at home). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options'.
options_doc: player_swing: holding the interact key near a build site hammers (a hammer beat every HunterTool.TOOLS.hammer.period seconds), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (none on a skip).

hints.go: This is your Boki. Walk up and say hello.

steps.title: Feed it

hints.go: Click your Boki (or press {details} next to it), choose Feed and give it the {food}: watch its colour change.

steps.boki: Is that a berry? For me?

steps.title: Place a toy

hints.place: Press {build}, open Base and set a toy down.
hints.watch: Watch your Boki go and play with it.

steps.boki: Can we have something to play with?

steps.title: Head out or stay

hints.go: Press {interact} at the portal to head out, or press Stay to keep playing. Later, the Waystone in your hub wakes the next zone.

steps.boki: Out there, or more play? Your call!

steps_doc: meet your Boki, feed it and watch it change, place a toy and watch it play, head out or stay. needs: steps that must be done first; spot: per hint stage, what FarmSpotlight lights up (hub: a bottom-bar button id, world: the step's marker in the world, a Boki); boki: the line it says over its head when the step comes up. start_food: a typed food, so the feed step shows the lean change. skip_toy: the toy put down on a skip, with the food handed over (a skipper loses nothing: no gems, items or tools are taken). near: tiles from your Boki that count as meeting it. lead: your Boki leads each step (scripts/home/base_tut_lead.gd): it waits and looks back when you are more than wait_m metres behind, and stops stop_m metres short of the place.

first_day.doc: A new save gets this short list in the Goals tracker (GardenFirstDay): one line each, ticked as the thing happens, one small gem reward when the last is ticked, then it is gone. Not tutorial steps. Saves made before it have no 'gfd' state and never see it.

rows.text: Pair two Boki in the Nook

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.
